publication_scope: Selected evidence from a live session that unlocked the bootloader, achieved root via Magisk, took a full non-userdata partition backup, and customized the boot animation. No raw partition images, APKs or firmware binaries are included; only text excerpts, hashes and a size/hash manifest.
private_source_paths: Relative to backups/oneplus-watch-2/. Originals remain excluded by /backups/ in .gitignore.

2026-10-21-root-magisk-sources/post-fs-d.description: Timestamped trace written by the Magisk module's post-fs-data.sh during a successful boot-animation mount, confirming execution order and timing.

2026-10-21-root-magisk-sources/full-logc.description: Full logcat buffer for the boot that resolved the bootanimation-plus.zip path discovery. Source for bootanimation-plus-discovery-excerpt.txt.

2026-10-21-full-system-backup/SHA256SUMS.description: SHA-256 digests of all 62 acquired non-userdata partition images. Source for system-backup-manifest.csv; the images themselves are not published.

other_evidence.magisk-architecture-bug-excerpts.txt: Reconstructed from in-session `file` and `adb getprop`/`adb logcat` command output at the time of the architecture-mismatch diagnosis; no single private log file backs this excerpt as a whole.
other_evidence.boot-patch-on-device-excerpt.txt: Reconstructed from the on-device boot_patch.sh run's own stdout, captured in-session via adb shell.

excluded_by_policy: The Magisk release APK and its extracted binaries
The custom boot animation PNG frames and packaged zip
userdata partition (not acquired by choice; contains the owner's personal data)
